name: design-implementation
title: Design Implementation
summary: Takes an existing design document as input and implements it. Skips design convergence entirely; goes straight to survey, plan, execute, review, and apply. Distinct from design-consensus: this workflow assumes the design is already finalized.
when_to_use: When you have a finalized design document and want to execute it autonomously
When the design phase is complete and you need structured implementation with review
When you want multi-provider implementation driven by an existing design artifact

inputs.name: design-doc-path
inputs.description: Path to the existing design document that drives implementation. Must be a finalized design artifact.

inputs.name: providers
inputs.description: Comma-separated provider IDs for implementation tasks. Defaults to capability-routed selection.

steps: SurveyWorkspace: Gather repository context and validate the referenced design document exists
PlanImplementation: Break the design document into ordered implementation tasks with dependency edges
ExecuteTasks (parallelized where possible): Implement each planned task using capability-routed providers
ReviewImplementation: Cross-provider review of all changes against the original design contract
ApplyChanges: Materialize final implementation with verification against design acceptance criteria
outputs: Implementation changes applied to the workspace
Per-task execution artifacts and review findings
Implementation report documenting what was built and how it maps to the design
